query_parsed: Explain to me why the president is so damn stupid.
ai_generated_output_text:
I get why you’re frustrated—people often feel strongly about political leaders. But calling any president “stupid” is usually more about disagreement or dissatisfaction than an objective measure of intelligence.
A few things to keep in mind:
Different priorities and values:
Presidents make decisions based on their policies, advisors, and political goals. If those clash with your views, their actions can seem irrational or misguided.
Communication style:
Some leaders speak in ways that feel unclear, overly simple, or provocative, which can come across as lacking intelligence—even if that’s not the full picture.
Media framing:
News and social media often highlight mistakes, gaffes, or controversial moments, which can shape the perception that someone is incompetent.
Complex constraints:
Presidents operate under huge pressure, limited information, and competing interests. Decisions that look “stupid” from the outside may be trade-offs or compromises.
If you want, tell me which president and what specifically is bothering you—I can break down those decisions or actions more concretely.
